sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 13 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：SPCX、SPY、SNDK、MU、NFLX。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Trump Announces Restart of Iran Blockade + 20% "Toll" on the Strait of Hormuz: The White House said the U.S. will become the "Guardian" of the Strait and collect a 20% "security reimbursement fee" based on cargo value from all goods in transit, while Iranian vessels will remain blockaded. Oil prices jumped—Brent +4.7% to around $79.6, WTI +4.8% to around $74.7, with Brent briefly reclaiming $80 at midday. The community interpreted this as an indirect tax hike even harsher than "closing the Strait," and no longer expects a TACO (backing down and reversing course).
  • South Korea’s "Black Monday": KOSPI closed at 6,806.93 (-8.95%), breaking below 7000 and triggering the 7th circuit breaker of the year and the 35th program-trading halt; SK Hynix plunged 15.37% (a record), Samsung -10.7%. The triggers were "sell the news" after the ADR listing, KIS cutting Q2 profit expectations, and geopolitical risk aversion. This was the direct source of pressure on the U.S. semiconductor chain.
  • U.S. Stocks at This Moment (Monday 13:13 ET Intraday) Broadly Lower but Indices Holding Up: SPY $750.28 (-0.62%, intraday low 748.94, firmly defending 750), QQQ $713.96 (-1.60%) was clearly weaker under semiconductor pressure, DIA only -0.27% and relatively resilient, IWM -0.65%. Memory/semiconductors were the disaster zone: SNDK -11.1%, SOXL -13.2%, MRVL -7.0%, INTC -5.6%, NVDA -2.9%, MU -4.6% (dumped to 903 intraday before rebounding to 934).
  • MSFT Becomes the "New VIX": +1.95% to $392.61, the only mega-cap bucking the trend and turning green. The community joked it has become an "inverse QQQ / reverse ETF." RDDT +3.9% and NFLX +1.4% were the other two green spots.
  • Dual Catalysts Tomorrow: 7/14 pre-market June CPI (headline inflation expected to fall to around 3.7–3.9%, but core still sticky at +0.3% MoM / around 2.9% YoY) + major bank earnings (JPM/GS/BofA/WFC/Citi) all arrive together, compounded by Warsh’s first Congressional testimony. Fed’s Waller said today: if core CPI is hot again this week, the FOMC needs to consider near-term tightening—rate-hike talk is back on the table.

社区氛围：极度悲观、疲惫、麻木——屏幕上满是“无法交易/无法投资/我想摆脱这趟旅程”。散户交易者在内存和空间的双重杀戮中不断被止损，对反复的V型反弹失去了信心，普遍等待明天的CPI“要么登月，要么崩盘”。情感底线是黑色幽默式的集体投降。

恐惧/贪婪：倾向于恐惧，但未达到崩溃水平。 VIX只有16左右，被社区嘲笑为“最容易操纵的指标”。真正的痛苦来自个股而不是指数——许多成长型股票在 6 周内下跌了 20-60%，而 SPY 的跌幅还不到 ATH 的 1.5%。这种分歧是当今所有怨恨的根源。

WSB 情绪与实际市场行为：严重分歧。评论区充斥着“金融崩溃/罗马沦陷”级别的哀嚎，但SPY仅为-0.6%，DIA则近乎持平。一些理性的声音反复提醒人们“该指数距离ATH只有1%”，结果却被愤怒地拒绝了，“再说一遍，把你的家庭地址发给我，这样我就可以打败你了”——痛苦在于高贝塔人工智能/半导体/太空的账户，而不是大盘。
